The '''PED-21 Distress Beacon''' was an emergency [[Distress beacon/Legends|distress beacon]]. It was a hyperspace-capable transmitter with enough range to cover an entire system and all nearby hyperspace lanes. It would allow a ship to detect and follow the signal. It had a 10 year continuous operation lifespan.
